document.title: Future Idea: Sender Newness Declaration
document.purpose: Consider allowing a sender to declare whether a request is definitely new or may be a resend.

idea.potential-use: A sender that lost its own send record after a crash could communicate how much duplicate uncertainty it has.
idea.caution: A sender declaration cannot be treated as proof. A false newness declaration could cause duplicate execution of a non-idempotent task.
